sources_checked.claim: Proxy mode intercepts external calls, configures transactional beans, and AspectJ weaving is a separate bytecode mechanism; visibility/defaults described.
JDK/CGLIB proxy limits: final/private cannot be advised; self-invocation bypasses advice.
Boot transaction management auto-configuration is conditional on TransactionManager and missing AbstractTransactionManagementConfiguration, then applies @EnableTransactionManagement.
